end.summary:
Identified plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows, including grass → grasshopper → frog → snake.
Explained that plants make food in their leaves using sunlight and water.
Described effects of fewer owls and bees on mice, crops, fruits, and vegetables.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Manav practised grouping animals by what they eat and reading simple food chains with arrows. They used the food-chain method correctly in examples such as grass → deer → lion and explained how changes in one part can affect other organisms. Asha also practised how plants make food in their leaves and how bees support fruit and vegetable production. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and explain what might happen if one organism disappeared.
